title: Normal: the delivery driver left a package with a neighbor

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: Hi, this is Luis with Speedy Delivery. I had a package for Mrs. Díaz at apartment 4C.

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: Nobody answered the door, so I left it with your neighbor in 4D, Mr. Patel. He said that was fine.

lines.speaker: senior
lines.text: Oh good, that's my medicine. Thank you.

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: No problem. There's nothing to pay, it's all taken care of. Have a good day!
